meta.name: openspec-explore
meta.description: Enter explore mode - a thinking partner for exploring ideas, investigating problems, and clarifying requirements. Use when the user wants to think through something before or during a change.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法梳理成清晰需求
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你做事前总想先把问题想清楚再动手。
copy.tagline_en: Clarify vague ideas into actionable requirements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you like to think things through before starting a change.

howto.what: Claude 会进入『探索模式』:不写代码,只当你的思考伙伴。它会提问、梳理问题、查看现有代码、画示意图帮你理清思路;经你同意,还能生成提案、设计等文档来记下结论。
howto.when: 当你想在动手改动之前或期间,先想清楚某个模糊想法、具体问题,或想比较几个方案时,Claude 会进入探索模式。若你提到现有的变更,它还会先查看相关文档。

say.text: 我有个模糊想法:想给应用加实时协作,但我还没想清楚。
say.note: Claude会画出协作功能的分层图,陪你理清需求。

say.text: 我们的认证系统有点乱,帮我看看问题在哪。
say.note: 它会读代码库,画出当前认证流程图,指出关键问题。

say.text: 帮我比较 SQLite 和 Postgres 哪个适合这个 CLI 工具。
say.note: Claude会列出对比与取舍,并给出倾向性建议。

howto.what_en: Claude enters explore mode and acts as a thinking partner, not an implementer. It asks questions, inspects the codebase, draws ASCII diagrams, compares options, and may create OpenSpec proposals or design docs if asked.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to think something through before or during a change—for example, a vague idea, a specific problem, or comparing options. If an existing change is mentioned, Claude first reads its artifacts.

say_en.text: I have a vague idea: add real-time collaboration to our app. Not clear yet.
say_en.note: Enters explore mode and maps out the idea to clarify.

say_en.text: Our auth system is a mess—could you look into it?
say_en.note: Reads the code, draws the auth flow, highlights key issues.

say_en.text: Help me compare SQLite vs Postgres for this CLI tool.
say_en.note: Claude builds a comparison table and gives a recommendation.
